339-677-1115-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1339-1832-2034-6559.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-6559.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat from step 1.

1170-3698-5131-5705--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-5131-5705--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1} due to Glaring Fleshraker.
Displacer Kitten and Glaring Fleshraker's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact, causing a player to mill three cards
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
6797-6972-7936.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

348-1152-2992-6112-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2992-6112-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Fumulus triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

1987-3075-4477.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3075-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1987-3075-4477.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3075-4477.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1263-2511-3220-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6154.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6154.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2173-2292-5220-6772.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2263-2438-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

5086-5183-5231-6705-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
5086-5183-5231-6705-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

245-1069-5499-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-5499-7060.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

1308-2034-5220-5477-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1308-2034-5220-5477-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

457-4785-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-4785-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

3602-3967--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3602-3967--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

413-2584-4133.description:
Cast Soul Collector by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Soul Collector enters the battlefield, Pandemonium and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve Blasting Station's trigger, untapping it.
Resolve Pandemonium's trigger, causing Soul Collector to deal damage to itself equal to its power.
If an activated ability from Blasting Station is waiting to resolve, let it resolve.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Soul Collector.
When Soul Collector dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3456-4499-4605.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Rapacious Dragon.
When Rapacious Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Rapacious Dragon trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Rapacious Dragon that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Rapacious Dragon token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of River Kelpie

2438-3388-3607.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of River Kelpie with one +1/+1 counter on it due to its persist ability and its static effect.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it and River Kelpie's first ability triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it. 
Repeat.

2178-4100.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Endbringer.
Endbringer does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Endbringer deathtouch.
2178-4100.description:
Give Endbringer deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Endbringer's first ability by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent's creature and destroying it due to Endbringer's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Endbringer triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control if you have a way to give Endbringer deathtouch indefinitely.

914-2034-2178-3379.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
Thornbite Staff attached to Adun.
Adun does not have summoning sickness.
914-2034-2178-3379.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Adun triggers, untapping Adun.
Activate Adun by paying {B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-1069-2018-4232.description:
Pay {0} to equip Luminous Broodmoth with Magebane Armor.
Tap Blasting Station, sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth to deal 1 damage to any target.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning itself to the battlefield with a flying counter.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more +1/+1 counters on it

2-3771.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2-3771.notes: You can start the combo if Animar has fewer +1/+1 counters on it, but will need to provide mana to compensate.
